info.title: Physio Scheduler Calendar API
info.description: Read-only FullCalendar feed for the signed-in physiotherapist. All stored and returned appointment times are naive clinic-local times. See calendar_api.md for timezone and integration requirements.

servers.description: Application root; include the deployment prefix when mounted below a subpath.

get.summary: List the current physiotherapist's calendar events
get.description: Returns overlapping appointments in [start, end), sorted by start time then ID. Start and end are required and may span at most 93 clinic-local days. All statuses are included unless filtered. Duplicate and unsupported parameters are rejected. No owner override is accepted. The feed is a bare array, not a paginated data envelope; ranges exceeding 1,000 events return 422 instead of truncated data.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Inclusive query boundary. Extended ISO date, naive local datetime, or datetime with Z/numeric offset. Both bounds must use the same awareness mode. Offset instants are converted to server-local clinic time.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Exclusive query boundary after start, at most 93 local days later. An event ending exactly at start or starting exactly at end is excluded.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional exact status filter; omission includes history as well as confirmed appointments.

parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.description: FullCalendar timezone metadata. Only local is supported by the existing naive clinic-local timestamp contract; use a clinic-local browser and server.

200.description: All matching owned appointments, or an empty array. Private, no-store; Vary: Cookie.

400.description: Missing, malformed, duplicate, unsupported or excessive query parameters.

401.description: No valid authenticated user session. No HTML login redirect.

403.description: Authenticated account does not have the physio role.

405.description: Mutation methods are not accepted. This is Flask's standard routing response and can be HTML.

422.description: The requested range contains more than 1,000 owned matching events; request a smaller range.

example.error: Too many events in this range. Choose a smaller date range.

500.description: Unexpected application failure, with no exception details in the response.

example.error: Calendar data is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.

cookieAuth.name: session
cookieAuth.description: Existing signed Flask-Login browser session. Sign in through /auth/login; never copy cookies or credentials into frontend code.

id.description: Appointment ID, retaining the project's integer JSON contract.

title.description: Appointment reason as untrusted text, not HTML.

start.description: Naive clinic-local ISO datetime, with optional fractional seconds; intentionally not RFC3339 date-time because it has no UTC offset.

end.description: Exclusive appointment end in naive clinic-local ISO datetime format.

url.description: Application-relative detail URL generated by url_for, including any application mount prefix.
